Verified domain novacredit.com; New York/San Francisco-based alternative credit data company (Credit Passport cross-border reports, Cash Atlas cash-flow underwriting), founded at Stanford by Misha Esipov, Nicky Goulimis and Loek Janssen (YC 2016). Rounds: $16M Series A in 2018 (General Catalyst, Index; FinSMEs/PYMNTS via FT), $50M Series B in Feb 2020 led by Kleiner Perkins (TechCrunch: just under $20M raised before it, incl. YC), $45M Series C in Oct 2023 led by Canapi, and $35M Series D in Oct 2025 led by Socium Ventures (Cox). amount_raised sums the sourced Series A–D only ($16M+$50M+$45M+$35M). Early YC/Index seed money (~$4M implied) is excluded because no amount was sourced. Pear entered at Pre-Seed.
